description: Fresh cut, sharp frames, sharper mind. The Professor plans the patrol routes the rest of the Foxwatch just walks.
name: The Professor — Foxwatch Strategist

description: No orders, no schedule, no problem. The Drifter ranges beyond the marked trails and reports back only when it matters.
name: The Drifter — Foxwatch Outrider

description: She knows every hive within ten miles and the Foxwatch eats because of it. The 'Honey Honey' tag is her signature on every jar.
name: Honey — Foxwatch Forager

description: Every den needs someone who keeps the canteens full. The Traveler drinks deep and shares deeper.
name: The Traveler — Foxwatch Quartermaster

description: Not a fox, and nobody in the Foxwatch mentions it. When the heavy work starts, the Lion is already there.
name: The Lion — Foxwatch Heavy

description: Mask on, badge out. The Medic has patched up half the Foxwatch and asks for nothing but a quiet corner afterward.
name: The Medic — Foxwatch Corpsman

description: Scarf against the evening grass, eyes on the horizon. The Ranger walks point so the column never walks blind.
name: The Ranger — Foxwatch Pathfinder

description: Wrapped tight against the cold, dreaming in patrol patterns. Even asleep, the Sleeper is on watch.
name: The Sleeper — Foxwatch Dreamer

description: Number one, ball at her feet, geometric heart. The Captain runs the Foxwatch drills and never loses a scrimmage.
name: The Captain — Foxwatch Striker

description: Big eyes, clean coat, cleaner record. The Watcher takes the night shift and has never missed a thing.
name: The Watcher — Foxwatch Sentinel

description: Half-lidded eyes that have seen every season. The Veteran teaches the young ones what the manuals leave out.
name: The Veteran — Foxwatch Old Guard

description: Honeycomb patterned into her very fur. The Beekeeper tends the hives that keep the Foxwatch fed through winter.
name: The Beekeeper — Foxwatch Harvester

description: Leaf-wrapped and dapple-furred, gone before you blink. The Ghost scouts the places the patrols can't reach.
name: The Ghost — Foxwatch Infiltrator
